new_learnings.text: When IV Rank is extreme (84%+ overall) AND breadth is euphoric (5:1, 0跌停), this historically marks a capitulation bounce. The 0-risk, high-score names in hot sectors are the best vehicles — tight stops handle downside if wrong.
new_learnings.related_hypothesis: h077 (hard block prevents FOMO entries in panic — opposite regime today confirms: when block is off, go but go selective)
new_learnings.mechanism: Capitulation bounces produce the strongest short-term returns but also carry gap risk. Hot sector + near MA support + 0 risks = optimal risk/reward.

new_learnings.text: The '元件' sector today benefits from a rare trifecta: (a) MLCC涨价 from Samsung/太阳诱电, (b) AI server PCB demand from Vera Rubin ramp, (c) 电子布价格五连涨. Multiple sub-sector catalysts converging = higher persistence than single-theme sector moves.
new_learnings.mechanism: Multi-catalyst sectors have lower probability of one-day reversals. MLCC + PCB + 电子布 all have different demand drivers but converge on the same sector, creating persistent momentum.

new_learnings.text: MA data for stocks with recent corporate actions (splits, major dividends, restructurings) can show absurdly high negative dist values (-80% to -96%). These should be flagged as 'unreliable MA data' and excluded from MA-based decisions.
new_learnings.mechanism: Stocks like 紫光股份 (dist_ma5=-85.9%), 冰轮环境 (-95.5%), 中国巨石 (-94.0%) show MA values that clearly haven't been adjusted for stock splits. Using these for Rule 2b would produce false negatives.

new_learnings.text: Rule 2b (MA-distance) blocked 中船特气, 西部矿业, 中远海特 today — three stocks with strong fundamentals that are technically overextended. Without this rule, V1 would have chased into mean-reversion risk. The rule earns its place as non-negotiable.
new_learnings.mechanism: Even in strong entry regimes and hot sectors, buying >6% above MA5 creates immediate -3% to -5% drawdown risk on any rotation. The rule converts FOMO entries into pullback entries.

new_learnings.text: 药明康德's VCP SETUP (contraction_ratio=0.99, within 1.5% of all three MAs) is not 'PREMIUM' quality but still meaningful: a 0.99 ratio means the stock is compressing near its recent range, with the MA cluster acting as a launchpad. Combined with imminent earnings (8/4), this is a classic 'coiled spring' pattern.
new_learnings.mechanism: When all three MAs (5/10/20) converge within 1.5% of price, volatility compression is extreme. The next catalyst (earnings) is likely to resolve the compression directionally — favoring the existing uptrend (RPS120=90.81%, 3-month momentum top 2%).
